allowed_dependency_manifest.content: For every choice of integers n, k, l with 0 <= k <= n and 0 <= l <= n, if the quotient of the Gaussian q-binomial coefficient [n choose k]_q by [n choose l]_q is itself a polynomial in q, then that polynomial has all coefficients nonnegative.

forbidden_claims.statement_nl: Let [n choose k]_q denote the Gaussian q-binomial coefficient. Prove that for all integers n, k, ℓ with 0 ≤ k, ℓ ≤ n, if [n choose k]_q / [n choose ℓ]_q is a polynomial in q, then it has only nonnegative coefficients.

statement_nl: For integers n, a, b with 0 <= a <= b and a + b <= n, define r := n - a - b. Then the quotient of Gaussian q-binomial coefficients satisfies [n choose b]_q / [n choose a]_q = product_{i=a+1}^{b} ((1 - q^(r+i)) / (1 - q^i)), where [n choose t]_q := (q;q)_n / ((q;q)_t (q;q)_{n-t}), (q;q)_m := product_{j=1}^m (1 - q^j), (q;q)_0 := 1, and an empty product is interpreted as 1.
